telegram.title: Connect Telegram
telegram.guideIntro: In Telegram, bots are created by chatting with an official account called BotFather. It's free and takes about 2 minutes.
guideSteps: Tap the button below to open BotFather in Telegram.
Give your bot a name (for example: "My Assistant").
Give it a username that ends in "bot" (for example: myassistant_bot).
BotFather will reply with a long code. That code is what you need here.
telegram.tokenTitle: Paste the code BotFather gave you
telegram.tokenIntro: It's the long code in BotFather's last message. Tap it in Telegram to copy it, then paste it here.
telegram.whoTitle: Who can talk to your assistant?
telegram.whoEveryoneHint: Anyone who finds your bot on Telegram can chat with it. The easiest way to start — you can change this later.
telegram.whoSpecificHint: Paste the Telegram IDs of the allowed people, separated by commas. To find an ID, open @userinfobot in Telegram and press Start.
telegram.successTitle: Your assistant is live on Telegram!
telegram.successBody: Open a chat with @{{bot}} and send it a message — it will reply.

whatsapp.title: Connect WhatsApp
whatsapp.guideTitle: Link WhatsApp with a QR code
whatsapp.guideIntro: This works exactly like WhatsApp Web: you scan a code with your phone, and from then on your assistant replies from that WhatsApp account.
guideSteps: Keep your phone nearby, with WhatsApp installed.
Tap the button below to show the QR code.
On your phone, open WhatsApp → Settings → Linked devices → Link a device.
Point your phone's camera at the code on this screen.
whatsapp.qrTitle: Scan this code with your phone
qrSteps: Tap "Link a device" and scan this code
whatsapp.successBody: Send a message to that WhatsApp account and your assistant will reply.

discord.title: Connect Discord
discord.guideIntro: Discord bots are created on Discord's website. It's free — just follow these steps in order.
guideSteps: Tap the button below and sign in with your Discord account.
Press "New Application", give it a name, and press "Create".
Turn ON "Message Content Intent" (under "Privileged Gateway Intents") and save.
Press "Reset Token", then "Copy". That code is what you need here.
discord.tokenIntro: It's the code you copied after pressing "Reset Token".
discord.inviteTitle: Invite the bot to your server
discord.inviteIntro: Your bot exists! Now it needs to join your server, and we need your server's ID so it knows where to reply.
inviteSteps: Tap "Invite to my server", pick your server and confirm.
In Discord, open Settings → Advanced and turn on "Developer Mode".
Right-click your server's icon (left sidebar) and choose "Copy Server ID".
discord.successBody: Go to your server and mention @{{bot}} in any channel — it will reply.
